criterion_notes: A chunk is relevant when its component solves the same technical problem the query describes, regardless of the client's sector. Estimation is driven by comparable engineering work, not by industry: an OAuth server costs roughly the same whether the client is a bank or a gym. Chunks that merely share vocabulary with the query (payments in a checkout vs a peer-to-peer wallet ledger) are deliberately annotated as NOT relevant — separating those is what reranking has to prove.

queries.query: Necesitamos una tienda online con catálogo de productos, carrito de la compra y proceso de pago para vender ropa por internet

relevance_notes.8: Product catalogue service — the core of the request.
relevance_notes.9: Cart and checkout — explicitly asked for.
relevance_notes.10: Payment gateway integration, i.e. paying at checkout.
relevance_notes.4: Product catalog service from the English seed budget, same work.
relevance_notes.16: Commerce API layer exposing catalogue, cart and orders.

deliberate_distractors.17: Payment processing engine for peer-to-peer wallets — shares the word 'pago' but is a ledger, not a checkout.
deliberate_distractors.63: Municipal tax payment — also 'pago', unrelated work.

queries.query: Queremos un buscador con filtros por precio y valoración sobre un catálogo grande, que responda rápido
queries.intent: Faceted search over a large catalogue.

relevance_notes.14: Faceted product search with price and rating filters — exact match.
relevance_notes.8: Catalogue with full-text search over product attributes.
relevance_notes.45: Availability and price search across providers with result normalisation and caching — same search engineering, travel sector.
relevance_notes.4: Catalogue with full-text search over attributes (English seed).

deliberate_distractors.41: Content recommendation engine — surfaces items but is not query-driven search.

queries.query: Hay que implementar login con OAuth 2.0, autenticación de doble factor y cumplir la normativa de protección de datos

relevance_notes.2: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend (English seed) — same work.
relevance_notes.21: PSD2 strong customer authentication, i.e. second factor plus compliance.
relevance_notes.18: Identity verification with document capture and sanctions screening.
relevance_notes.61: Digital certificate identification and signing — same authentication problem in the public sector.
relevance_notes.6: HIPAA audit log service — access logging for regulatory compliance.

deliberate_distractors.69: QR access control for a gym turnstile — 'acceso' but physical, not OAuth.
deliberate_distractors.26: Electronic health record with GDPR access logging — compliance is incidental, the component is storage.

queries.query: Queremos una app móvil donde los usuarios reserven cita y reciban avisos, con agenda y recordatorios automáticos
queries.intent: Appointment booking with reminders and scheduling.

relevance_notes.25: Appointment booking with medical agendas, waiting list and SMS reminders — exact match.
relevance_notes.64: Mass appointment assignment by time slot with configurable capacity.
relevance_notes.68: Class booking with limited places, waiting list and cancellation rules.
relevance_notes.46: Booking engine with confirmation and cancellation handling — same reservation work.
relevance_notes.48: Room availability and occupancy management, i.e. booking a slot.

deliberate_distractors.27: Video consultation — adjacent to appointments but a different component.
deliberate_distractors.38: School messaging — notifications, but not booking.

queries.query: Necesitamos un panel que reciba datos de sensores en tiempo real y avise cuando algo va mal en la instalación

relevance_notes.53: Inverter telemetry ingestion every five minutes with unit normalisation.
relevance_notes.54: Production dashboard — the panel asked for.
relevance_notes.55: Low-performance alerts against expected history — the alerting asked for.
relevance_notes.56: Continuous vibration and temperature sensor collection from plant PLCs.
relevance_notes.57: Failure prediction from sensor history — detecting that something is wrong.
relevance_notes.59: Line efficiency measurement with stoppage cause breakdown.
relevance_notes.31: Real-time GPS fleet ingestion with route deviation alerts — same telemetry-plus-alerting work.

deliberate_distractors.58: Maintenance work orders — downstream of alerting, not the panel itself.
deliberate_distractors.42: Multiplatform player — real-time streaming, unrelated to sensors.
